# `company.payroll_paycheck_events`

PRIVATE immutable paycheck history: reasons and directives never reach general audit.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Event ULID. |
| `paycheck_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | payroll_paychecks.id | Paycheck. |
| `action` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | post, pay_net, void_payment, void, or the same under batch reverse. |
| `version` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Paycheck version after this event. |
| `reason` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | PRIVATE reason supplied for this write. |
| `directive_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | Directive the write was made under, kept privately. |
